annotations.title: Turn off a result's link or a model's share token

description: Turns off the public link to one of your results, or the share token of one of your saved models, and keeps the result or the model: nothing is deleted, and it can be shared again. Use this when the user wants something they shared to stop working but wants to keep it. For a result's link, pass the run_id of the shared result (not the link). For a model's share token, pass the graph_id of the model you shared with create_model_share_link (not the token). Pass one of the two, not both. When the user wants the result itself removed, use delete_run instead: it deletes the result and its link. From then on anyone who opens the old link, or passes the old token to get_graph, gets "not found", and it never works again, even if you share again. That cannot be undone for the people who hold the old link or token, and it is why this tool is marked destructive; the result or model itself is kept. A copy someone already saved with save_graph is theirs and is not affected. It returns revoked true, or false when there was no active link or token, so calling it again is harmless. To share again, call create_result_share_link or create_model_share_link: each makes a new link or token. It needs a Neumann account: send your key, or your signed-in token, in the Authorization header as a Bearer credential. No Neumann tool takes an api_key argument. Cost: free -- it debits no credits and spends none of your free daily runs -- but it needs an account; an anonymous caller gets account_required.

graph_id.description: The saved graph whose share token to turn off, as passed to create_model_share_link. The model is kept. Omit it when you pass run_id.
graph_id.title: Graph Id

run_id.description: The run whose public link to turn off, as passed to create_result_share_link. The result is kept. Omit it when you pass graph_id.
run_id.title: Run Id
